title: Three Days and One Short Basket
subtitle: 城市生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）
meta: 主题语境：城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）　|　核心词汇：mall　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 mall 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1996 the manager ① opened the mall that no shopper in the arcade would have recorded, and he said the opening was the whole of the day. The ② mall, meaning the centre itself and not the basket, ran three days and stayed unrecorded in the book; a mall, he said, is the only thing in an arcade that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ mall in that arcade had the same short basket beside it, and the ④ mall at the far entrance, meaning the shop they kept for the children to visit and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A mall, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the manager said the recording is the part that fills three days.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the mall was the whole of the matter, meaning the crowd and not the centre. The ⑥ mall, meaning the crowd and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; mall, he said, is either something you open or the only word that means both a centre and a crowd. He said the crowd is the part they remember.

By 2001 the ⑦ mall had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short basket. The ⑧ mall of the whole thing, the manager wrote in November, was one arcade and three days of recording; mall, he said, is either the shop at the far entrance or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ mall I remember is the centre recorded in the plan, which closed in 2003 and is still recorded as the quietest in the arcade. A ⑩ mall, my mother said in 2005, is the only centre that improves by being recorded; every mall, she said, is a crowd that has agreed to look like a centre. She said the crowd was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 购物中心；商场（指商业街里每一座旁边的那一座）
B. n. 购物中心；商场（指那座购物中心本身，与推篮相对）
C. 固定搭配：open the mall 开张这座商场
D. n. 购物中心；商场（指留给孩子们逛的那一家那一座）
E. n. 商圈之事（抽象总称，指一处商业街的商场之事）
F. n. 购物中心；商场（指平面图里写到、被记载的的那一座）
G. n. 人流、热闹（指一件事里人人都逛却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 热闹（抽象总称，指人人都逛却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: opened the mall that no shopper in the arcade would have recorded
The mall, meaning the centre itself and not the basket
the mall at the far entrance
the mall was the whole of the matter
the mall had become a line in a plan
The mall of the whole thing
A mall, my mother said in 2005

answers.why: open the mall 意为“开张这座商场”，1996 年那位经理把商业街里没有一位顾客肯记载的一座商场做了一遍。
mall 意为“购物中心；商场”，指那座购物中心本身而不是推篮，它经过了三个日子而在簿子上没有被记载。
mall 意为“购物中心；商场”，指商业街里每一座旁边的那一座，每一座旁边都有同一只小小的推篮。
mall 意为“购物中心；商场”，指最远那处入口留给孩子们逛的那一家那一座，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
mall 意为“人流、热闹”，指一件事里人人都逛却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份热闹就是那件事的全部。
mall 意为“热闹”，指人人都逛却无人提起的那样东西而不是那座购物中心，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
mall 意为“购物中心；商场”，指平面图里写到、被记载的的那一座，到 2001 年这一座成了平面图里的一行。
mall 意为“商圈之事”，经理十一月写道，整件事的商场之事是一处商业街和三个日子的记载。
mall 意为“购物中心；商场”，我记得的是平面图里记载过的那一座，2003 年建好了，至今仍被说成商业街里最安静的一座。
mall 为抽象总称，母亲 2005 年说，商场是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的购物中心。
